title: Code for: An Interpretable Machine Learning Framework for Early- versus Late-Stage Classification of Breast Cancer from Gene Expression, with Co-expression Network Analysis
description: Analysis notebook, reference outputs and Supplementary Table S4 for a study of early- (AJCC Stage I–II) versus late-stage (Stage III–IV) classification of TCGA-BRCA primary breast tumours (n = 1,075) from a 65-gene cancer panel, using leakage-aware evaluation of four classifiers, permutation importance, differential expression and co-expression network analysis. Input data are public TCGA-BRCA data from the UCSC Xena browser and are not included.
